sections.name: cn
sections.title: Combining style classes safely
sections.what: Joins the style class names it receives, skips empty or false values, and keeps only the later of two conflicting Tailwind styles.
sections.why: Likely reason: lets a caller's style override a component's default style.
sections.watch_out: When two styles conflict, the later one silently wins, so a caller's override must come last.

summary: A small helper that merges style class names into one string.
purpose: Lets a component combine its default styles with styles passed in by its caller without conflicts.
why: Reason not stated in the code. It is a common pattern for shared styled components.
how: 1. Accepts any number of class names, including empty or conditional ones. 2. Joins them into one list. 3. Resolves conflicting Tailwind styles so the last one wins.
inputs: Style class names, which may be empty, false, or conditional.
risks: The conflict rules come from an outside package, so an upgrade can change which style wins.
debug: If a style does not appear, check whether a later class overrides it. Check that the two outside packages are installed.
